high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore feed, showcasing a sponsored post by the account "thewhiteteak." The post features a modern wall light with two spherical glass shades that have a smoky grey finish. The wall light has a sleek black metal frame with a minimalist design, mounted on a plain white wall. The lighting of the glass shades creates a warm glow, highlighting their texture and shape. The post includes a call-to-action button labeled "Shop Now," indicating that viewers can purchase the product directly from the platform.
